theory.intro: Elapsed time is how much time passes between a start time and a finish time. Convert the times to 24-hour time, then subtract using the calculator's sexagesimal button.
facts: There are $60$ minutes in $1$ hour, so times 'roll over' at $60$, not $100$.
Use the sexagesimal button to enter hours and minutes; for example, $14^{\circ}30'$ represents $14$ hours $30$ minutes, not $14.30$ hours.
In $24$-hour time, afternoon hours are $12$ to $23$; e.g. $2{:}30$ pm $= 14{:}30$.
For a next-day finish, add $24$ hours to the finish time before subtracting.
To find a finish time, add the duration to the start time using the sexagesimal button. If the result reaches or exceeds $24$ hours, subtract $24$ hours and give the next-day time.
To find a start time, subtract the duration from the finish time using the sexagesimal button. If the result is negative, add $24$ hours and give the previous-day time.
steps: Convert the start time and the finish time to 24-hour time.
If the finish is on the next day, add 24 hours to the finish time.
Subtract the start time from the finish time using the sexagesimal button, then state the elapsed time in hours and minutes.

workedExamples.question_text: How much time passes between $9{:}45$ am and $2{:}20$ pm on the same day?
workedExamples.solution_text:
The times in 24-hour time are $09{:}45$ and $14{:}20$.
Using the sexagesimal button:
$14^{\circ}20'-9^{\circ}45'=4^{\circ}35'$
The elapsed time is $4$ hours $35$ minutes.

workedExamples.question_text: How much time passes between $9{:}46$ pm and $5{:}18$ am the next day?
workedExamples.solution_text:
The times in 24-hour time are $21{:}46$ and $05{:}18$.
Add $24$ hours to the next-day finish time:
$5^{\circ}18'+24^{\circ}=29^{\circ}18'$
Subtract the start time using the sexagesimal button:
$29^{\circ}18'-21^{\circ}46'=7^{\circ}32'$
The elapsed time is $7$ hours $32$ minutes.

workedExamples.question_text: A movie starts at $10{:}40$ am and runs for $2$ hours $35$ minutes. When does it finish? Give your answer in 12-hour time.
workedExamples.solution_text:
The start time in 24-hour time is $10{:}40$.
Add the duration using the sexagesimal button:
$10^{\circ}40'+2^{\circ}35'=13^{\circ}15'$
The movie finishes at $1{:}15$ pm.

workedExamples.question_text: A train leaves at $10{:}25$ pm on Tuesday. Its journey lasts $6$ hours $50$ minutes. On which day and at what time does it arrive?
workedExamples.solution_text:
The start time in 24-hour time is $22{:}25$.
Add the duration using the sexagesimal button:
$22^{\circ}25'+6^{\circ}50'=29^{\circ}15'$
Subtract $24$ hours to find the next-day time:
$29^{\circ}15'-24^{\circ}=5^{\circ}15'$
The train arrives at $5{:}15$ am on Wednesday.

workedExamples.question_text: A movie ends at $3{:}42$ pm after running for $2$ hours $28$ minutes. When did it start? Give your answer in 12-hour time.
workedExamples.solution_text:
The finish time in 24-hour time is $15{:}42$.
Subtract the duration using the sexagesimal button:
$15^{\circ}42'-2^{\circ}28'=13^{\circ}14'$
The movie started at $1{:}14$ pm.

workedExamples.question_text: A meal needs $7$ hours $40$ minutes to cook. It must be ready at $6{:}15$ am on Saturday. On which day and at what time should cooking start?
workedExamples.solution_text:
The finish time in 24-hour time is $06{:}15$.
Subtract the duration using the sexagesimal button:
$6^{\circ}15'-7^{\circ}40'=-1^{\circ}25'$
The result is negative, so add $24$ hours:
$-1^{\circ}25'+24^{\circ}=22^{\circ}35'$
Cooking should start at $10{:}35$ pm on Friday.

workedExamples.question_text: Mia puts a cake in the oven at $1{:}50$ pm. She adds biscuits $25$ minutes later. Both bake together for another $40$ minutes before she takes them out. At what time does she take them out?
workedExamples.solution_text:
The start time in 24-hour time is $13{:}50$.
Add the first duration using the sexagesimal button:
$13^{\circ}50'+0^{\circ}25'=14^{\circ}15'$
The biscuits go in at $2{:}15$ pm.
Add the time they bake together:
$14^{\circ}15'+0^{\circ}40'=14^{\circ}55'$
Mia takes both out at $2{:}55$ pm.

foundation.question_text: How much time passes from $9{:}20$ am to $10{:}05$ am?
foundation.solution_text:
The times in 24-hour time are $09{:}20$ and $10{:}05$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $10^{\circ}05'-9^{\circ}20'=0^{\circ}45'$.
The elapsed time is $45\text{ min}$.

foundation.question_text: How much time passes from $13{:}45$ to $15{:}10$?
foundation.solution_text:
The times are already in 24-hour time.
Using the sexagesimal button, $15^{\circ}10'-13^{\circ}45'=1^{\circ}25'$.
The elapsed time is $1\text{ h }25\text{ min}$.

foundation.question_text:
A lesson starts at $11{:}35$ am and lasts $50$ minutes.
When does it finish?
foundation.solution_text:
The start time in 24-hour time is $11{:}35$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $11^{\circ}35'+0^{\circ}50'=12^{\circ}25'$.
The lesson finishes at $12{:}25\text{ pm}$.

foundation.question_text:
A game finishes at $4{:}15$ pm after lasting $1$ hour $30$ minutes.
When did it start?
foundation.solution_text:
$4{:}15\text{ pm}=16{:}15$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $16^{\circ}15'-1^{\circ}30'=14^{\circ}45'$.
The game started at $2{:}45\text{ pm}$.

foundation.question_text: How much time passes from $0850$ to $1020$?
foundation.solution_text:
The times are $08{:}50$ and $10{:}20$ in 24-hour time.
Using the sexagesimal button, $10^{\circ}20'-8^{\circ}50'=1^{\circ}30'$.
The elapsed time is $1\text{ h }30\text{ min}$.

foundation.question_text:
A bus leaves at $1740$ and travels for $35$ minutes.
Find its arrival time.
foundation.solution_text:
The start time is $17{:}40$ in 24-hour time.
Using the sexagesimal button, $17^{\circ}40'+0^{\circ}35'=18^{\circ}15'$.
The arrival time is $1815$.

development.question_text: How long is it from $10{:}50$ pm to $12{:}25$ am the next day?
development.solution_text:
The times in 24-hour time are $22{:}50$ and $00{:}25$.
For the next-day finish, $0^{\circ}25'+24^{\circ}=24^{\circ}25'$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $24^{\circ}25'-22^{\circ}50'=1^{\circ}35'$.
The elapsed time is $1\text{ h }35\text{ min}$.

development.question_text:
A shift starts at $22{:}35$ and lasts $2$ hours $50$ minutes.
When does it finish?
development.solution_text:
Using the sexagesimal button, $22^{\circ}35'+2^{\circ}50'=25^{\circ}25'$.
$25^{\circ}25'-24^{\circ}=1^{\circ}25'$.
The shift finishes at $01{:}25$ the next day.

development.question_text:
A flight lands at $0610$ after a journey of $3$ hours $45$ minutes.
Find the departure time.
development.solution_text:
The finish time is $06{:}10$ in 24-hour time.
Using the sexagesimal button, $6^{\circ}10'-3^{\circ}45'=2^{\circ}25'$.
The departure time was $0225$.

development.question_text: Find the elapsed time from $11{:}48$ am to $2{:}17$ pm.
development.solution_text:
The times in 24-hour time are $11{:}48$ and $14{:}17$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $14^{\circ}17'-11^{\circ}48'=2^{\circ}29'$.
The elapsed time is $2\text{ h }29\text{ min}$.

development.question_text:
A timer started at $23{:}58$ and stopped at $00{:}13$.
How long did it run?
development.solution_text:
The finish is on the next day, so $0^{\circ}13'+24^{\circ}=24^{\circ}13'$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $24^{\circ}13'-23^{\circ}58'=0^{\circ}15'$.
The timer ran for $15\text{ min}$.

development.question_text:
An event ends at $15{:}05$.
It lasted $2$ hours $38$ minutes.
Find its start time.
development.solution_text:
Using the sexagesimal button, $15^{\circ}05'-2^{\circ}38'=12^{\circ}27'$.
The event started at $12{:}27$.

mastery.question_text:
A security log begins at $21{:}47$ and ends at $02{:}16$ the next day.
Find the elapsed time.
mastery.solution_text:
For the next-day finish, $2^{\circ}16'+24^{\circ}=26^{\circ}16'$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $26^{\circ}16'-21^{\circ}47'=4^{\circ}29'$.
The elapsed time is $4\text{ h }29\text{ min}$.

mastery.question_text:
A recording finished at $12{:}08$ am and lasted $2$ hours $53$ minutes.
On which day and at what time did it start?
mastery.solution_text:
$12{:}08\text{ am}=00{:}08$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $0^{\circ}08'-2^{\circ}53'=-2^{\circ}45'$.
The result is negative, so $-2^{\circ}45'+24^{\circ}=21^{\circ}15'$.
It started at $9{:}15$ pm on the previous day.

mastery.question_text:
A trip starts at $18{:}55$ and lasts $6$ hours $23$ minutes.
At what time does it finish?
mastery.solution_text:
Using the sexagesimal button, $18^{\circ}55'+6^{\circ}23'=25^{\circ}18'$.
$25^{\circ}18'-24^{\circ}=1^{\circ}18'$.
The trip finishes at $01{:}18$ the next day.
